title: AaronL725/grok-register
claim: AaronL725/grok-register — 【已存活三个月+，无封号】批量注册稳定 Grok 账号，可直接导入 grok2api 和 cpa 使用，并且可以与cloudflare无限域名邮箱等联动。通过1000+账号连续注册测试。
why_good: The integration with Cloudflare and bulk registration capabilities could streamline account management for businesses needing multiple Grok accounts.
value: Companies could pay for subscription plans based on the number of accounts managed, with tiered pricing for additional features like API access and support.
risk: The project may struggle to scale if Grok or Cloudflare introduces their own account management solutions, rendering it redundant.
